title: Repeated facts and repeated failures: consolidation under the offline default
description: Exact repeats, paraphrases and a repeated failure. The dataset opts into the M14 consolidation pass: contradiction resolution and decay run (fixtures are minutes old, so decay archives nothing), while the vector-gated passes (episodic-to-semantic derivation, near-duplicate merge) skip with recorded warnings because the offline default wires no embedder. The paraphrase pair therefore stays distinct offline — the honest measured ceiling of consolidation quality in the no-embedding default.
